title: onBeforeCompile materials share one program unless customProgramCacheKey differs
summary: three.js caches programs by onBeforeCompile.toString(): materials whose patches differ only in a captured number share the first one's program. Set customProgramCacheKey.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

doc.when: Every material with an onBeforeCompile patch built from parameters.
doc.avoid: Closures capturing per-instance numbers without a cache key.
gotchas: Literal numbers baked into the shader string make different programs only if the key differs.

problem.symptom: Several shells/outlines/glows with different parameters all look identical.
problem.cause: Program cache keyed by the onBeforeCompile function source, which is the same for every instance.
problem.detect: Changing one instance's parameter changes all of them, or none.
